title: ODRCC Tutorial
text: unguarded AIPW estimator adds IPW estimating equation augmentation term computed numerical integration working model \(f_{X \mid Y, Z}\). two choices working model: fx_method = "joint" (default, estimator manuscript): \(f_{X \mid Y, Z} \propto f_{Y \mid X, Z}\, f_{X \mid Z}\), \(f_{X \mid Z}\) joint MLE; fx_method = "direct": Weibull AFT model \(X \mid (Y, Z)\), survreg(Surv(W, D) ~ y + Z), fitted rows. fit valid \(C\) independent \(X\) given \((Y, Z)\). text: Generates one dataset design first simulation study manuscript: $$\log X = 0.1 + 0.1 Z + 0.5 \log E_X,$$ $$Y = 1 + (- X) + Z + \epsilon, \quad \epsilon \sim N(0, 1),$$ $$\log C = c_{int} + 0.1 Y + 0.1 Z + p_c \log E_C,$$ \(Z \sim N(0, 1)\), \(\sim N(2, 1)\), \(E_X, E_C \sim\) Exp(1), \(X | Z\) \(C | (Y, Z)\) follow Weibull AFT models \(C\) independent \(X\) given \((Y, Z)\). intercept c_int sets right-censoring rate, p.c sets spread \(\log C\) (scale ratio manuscript p.c / 0.5).

text: data_yXZ data frame one row per subject. must contain outcome, covariates model, age a_var, observed W = min(X, C), indicator D = (X <= C). model formula outcome model, y ~ AW + Z1 + ..., time--event covariate aw_var right-hand side. outcome model \(Y = \beta_0 + \beta_1 (- X) + \beta_Z' Z + \epsilon\), \(\epsilon \sim N(0, \sigma^2)\). aw_var Name column - W model. title: ODRCC 0.2.0
text: estimators now match revised manuscript code simulations/. estimators estimate theta = (beta, sigma) jointly return sandwich standard errors directly se_est. var_beta_*() functions removed. estimate_beta_mle() joint MLE: Weibull model X | Z estimated jointly outcome model (64-node Gauss-Legendre integration). estimate_beta_aipw() (unguarded AIPW) takes working model f_{X|Y,Z} joint MLE (fx_method = "joint", default) Weibull AFT model X | (Y, Z) (fx_method = "direct"). estimate_beta_aipw_lambda() (guarded AIPW) uses working normal model moments fitted Weibull model X | Z. standard errors IPW AIPW estimators account estimating model C | (Y, Z). New ess_weights(): effective sample size IPW weights. data_aft() now generates design first simulation study, arguments c_int (censoring rate) p.c (spread log C). number covariates outcome model, model_xz, model_weights. Dependencies reduced survival numDeriv.
